business_review.requirement: For each subagent, duration_ms equals the real run time from the Agent tool call until the subagent finished (tolerance ~1 s)
business_review.evidence: Re-evaluated after the final round. The background-agent anchor was the async launch ack, which arrives 1.9-8.3 s after the Agent call starts in all 32 real background dispatches in the local analytics DB, so durations fell short of the ticket's definition by more than the tolerance (session 52d226aa: 54355 / 24795 ms vs 56923 / 27242 ms). The anchor is now agent.tool.start for background and foreground agents alike (launch ack only as a fallback); it precedes the Agent tool span by 150-300 ms. Session 52d226aa via the API: 57102 / 27502 ms.
